record.title: Recover the complete post-ADC AFE calibration loader contract
record.intent: Derive both AFE loaders and reachable save-helper behavior before choosing another guest experiment.
requirements: Preserve the successful stock ADC evidence, original APK, native library and firmware byte-for-byte. Perform read-only static analysis and host-side derived artifacts only; no guest execution in this task.

Pin library ranges and recover dispatcher continuation from333bac through the two AFE loaders at333bcc and333bd8, stopping the scope before clock loading at333bf4. Resolve LoadAfeZeroCalData, LoadAfeBandWidthCalData, DrvCalibrationAfe_BandWidthSaveData and every reachable hardware-facing or filesystem operation on this path.

Recover primary/fallback file paths, record sizes, object offsets, return/error propagation, default initialization, loops and conditional save behavior. Inspect provided stock assets read-only with hashes; distinguish corpus absence from guest absence and from physical instrument state.

Produce a typed TOML operation graph separating STATIC-DETERMINED, RUNTIME-SELECTED, HARDWARE-RETURNED, ASYNCHRONOUS and UNKNOWN operations. Correlate current frozen guest filesystem with statically possible branches, explicitly retaining uncertain selectors and return values.

Independently check instruction/range identities and derived constants, using targeted host controls where a new semantic checker is introduced. Identify the smallest complete prediction and observation checkpoints without adding device responses or assuming success from the ADC result.
Commit and push the recovered contract and unresolved questions before the evaluation task.
acceptance: The whole AFE loader pair and its reachable side effects have a reproducible bounded static contract
or an exact unresolved boundary is documented.
